headline: Southwest Airlines (LUV) Stock Looks Fairly Priced After A 43% Run
summary: Southwest Airlines stock has delivered a solid 42.8% gain over the past three years, yet current valuation checks suggest the shares now look closer to fairly priced than like an obvious bargain. Over the last three years, Southwest Airlines has returned 42.8%, which puts recent weakness into context as more of a pullback within a longer positive run.
